parameter_policy: Select core parameters from strictly prior version-eligible event-year OOF; freeze the same parameters for direct and increment models. No re-tuning after adding baseline.
residual_features: same core + available_baseline for direct and increment, including station-hour interactions; do not clip signed residuals
baseline: same weekday, prior 7..56 days, nearest 4 with minimum 2; exclude recorded activity dates; official version_at <= D-1 18:00
calendar: No retrospectively revised holiday/calendar feature or matching; same weekday is only a proxy for comparable ordinary days
fusion: Ridge/GAM/XGBoost increment predictions, one simplex per outer year, only earlier temporal OOF with published labels; compare equal, MAE, window 1:1 and window 2:1
old_474: archived V12 reference only, not silently reclassified as D-1 eligible
deployment: not deployed; current public object version evidence does not prove historical public ACLs
